kind: two physical local libraries with two remote GPU brains
title: Can two physical pocket i find overlapping local knowledge and build one supported answer?
plain_language: MacBook and yukabox each open only their own Codex library. Each sends a few likely conversations to its own Qwen3-8B on a separate RTX 3090. The harness keeps every supported contribution and builds one answer.
question: Какие решения уже приняты для MVP pocket i о том, как локальный узел должен искать и отправлять полезное знание, и какие ошибки разрешено пока пропускать дальше?

local_library.allowed_records: visible user messages and visible assistant messages
local_library.selection: ordinary deterministic term ranking chooses at most three complete conversations before any Qwen inference
local_library.privacy_note: The owner explicitly accepted this for the test. It is not the final privacy architecture.

model.compute: one independent worker on each of two RTX 3090 GPUs

known_acceptable_noise: An absent answer may occasionally be returned as a FOUND claim saying that it is absent.
A correct answer may contain more evidence message IDs than minimally necessary.
sender_contract.critical_failure: A useful local answer exists but no node forwards it.

merge_contract.input: all FOUND capsules whose evidence IDs mechanically exist in the submitted conversation
merge_contract.used_shelf: smallest set of supported claims needed for the answer
merge_contract.other_shelf: duplicates, weaker versions, unresolved alternatives and noise remain visible for audit

claim_boundary: This tests physical local-library origin plus remote parallel inference and evidence-preserving merge. It does not keep private text on-device and it is not distributed neural inference.
